chapter: Queens Terrace, Decca records and Amen
title: The World's Fair, the fire and Ted Sturgis
summary: At the World's Fair in 1939 they play McGinnity's and are burned out across the street.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Where did you go from the Queens Terrace?
From the Queens Terrace-- also while we were at the Queens Terrace we went
to the World's Fair, 1939, and played at McGinneys, at the World's Fair.
When we finished our engagement at the World's Fair, we went across the street--that's where we had the fire, we were burned out--
Right across from the World's Fair.
This fellow, I saw him the other day, all that was left was the handle of his bass--
You're talking about Sturgis, Ted Sturgis.
He could also play alto too.
